title.narrative: Emergency support to improve the food and nutrition security of the conflict affected populaton in Ituri Province

description.narrative: Direct beneficiaries: 17,200 households (86,000 people) of which: An average of Returnees (40%), Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) in camps (30%), IDPs (20%), Host Families (10%)The main target group of the project interventions are IDPs without means. These are either located by host families or in IDP locations. Likewise, returnees who lost the last harvest and have no seeds for the next growing season are assisted. To release the hosting community of the burden they are carrying to support the IDP population, those found vulnerable are also assisted.
Restore the livelihoods for a peaceful and stable reconstruction in the intervention area. The food security and nutritional status of the conflict affected communities will be improved.
